comment: PlayerBots. Caps are DELIBERATELY EMPTY: with no values here a bot is built to exactly the limits Config/PlayerCaps.cfg gives players, which is this shard's authoritative source and already carries the EJ values (skill 100/700, stat 125/225). Set a value only to make bots deliberately different from players - the Bots.Population health check names every override so the divergence is never silent. Destination weights multiply: byType[type][class or default] times byTag[tag][class or default] for every tag the destination carries. Absent means 1.0 (no opinion); 0 excludes. home, guard and work are excluded outright - a bot has no business loitering on a guard post, at a crier's station, or inside somebody's house. Class templates, tier curves and the equipment tables live in code; see Scripts/Custom/Bots/README.md.
